events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles', more commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 2, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles dropped their self-titled double album, forever known as the 'White Album'. Still sounding as fresh today as it did back in '68.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died on November 24, 1991, and would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost one of the greatest showmen of all time. Freddie Mercury's legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A timeless classic. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61 today, an album that truly pushed the boundaries of pop music.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: December 8th marks the anniversary of the tragic death of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who passed away in 1980 and would have been 86.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a musical icon. John Lennon's message of peace and love still resonates.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Iconic musician David Bowie, born in 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: David Bowie Birthday
angles.copy: The Starman would have turned 80 today. Celebrating the incredible artistry and enduring legacy of David Bowie.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born in 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Birthday
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, still rocking the airwaves.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page, born in 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the guitar wizard, Jimmy Page! The man behind some of rock's greatest riffs.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic singer Rod Stewart, born in 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Still sailing. The one and only Rod Stewart turns 82 today. What's your favourite Rod tune?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson), born in 1961, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the legendary Suggs! Still bringing the house down with Madness.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer Paul Young, born in 1956, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Wherever I lay my hat, that's my home... and today it's Paul Young's 71st birthday! Still a true voice of the 80s.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton, born in 1946, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday
angles.copy: The queen of country turns 81! Wishing a very happy birthday to the incomparable Dolly Parton.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow, born in 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! Still going strong after all these years.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Soul and R&B singer Billy Ocean, born in 1950, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car... and wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday!

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first ceremony
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on January 24, 1986, honouring legends like Elvis Presley and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Rock Hall of Fame Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, rock history was made with the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who would you induct now?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, born in 1972, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Another Take That birthday! Mark Owen turns 55 today. Still got that youthful charm.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London on January 30, 1969.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Concert
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles played their final live show on a London rooftop. An unforgettable moment in music history.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins, born in 1951, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Against All Odds, Phil Collins turns 76 today! A true legend of drums and vocals.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Renowned British actor Hugh Grant, born in 1960, celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hugh Grant Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to Runcorn, he's a national treasure.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake, born in 1981, celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: He's bringing SexyBack for his 46th birthday! Happy birthday to the one and only Justin Timberlake.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, born in 1940, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Sir David Jason turns 87 today. A true legend of British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: February 3, 1959, marks the tragic day when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper died in a plane crash, an event famously known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: Day The Music Died
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we lost three pioneers of rock and roll. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British pop singer Rick Astley, born in 1966, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: Never gonna give you up... on wishing Rick Astley a very happy 61st birthday!

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley, born in 1945, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley Birthday
angles.copy: One love, one heart. Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His music continues to uplift and inspire.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King, born in 1942, celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole King Birthday
angles.copy: You've Got A Friend in Carole King, who turns 85 today! Celebrating a true songwriting genius.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of global superstar Whitney Houston, who died on February 11, 2012, and would have been 64.

angles.name: Whitney Houston Tribute
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost 'The Voice'. Remembering the incredible talent of Whitney Houston today.

events.title: Take That's original split anniversary
events.blurb: On February 13, 1996, pop sensation Take That announced their original split, leaving fans heartbroken.

angles.name: Take That Split Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember where you were? Thirty-one years ago today, Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they came back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell, born in 1959, celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Ali Campbell Birthday
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine... and a happy 68th birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell! Still bringing the reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global pop superstar Ed Sheeran, born in 1991, celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran Birthday
angles.copy: Thinking Out Loud, it's Ed Sheeran's 36th birthday! Wishing the ginger genius a great day.
